tasks.title: Define Configuration contracts and retained-root read/event ownership
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Under the selected P01–P08 profile, preserve existing diagnostic names; establish explicit marker/event, provider/result, retained-entry/default/prepared-value and reader contracts without a framework. Reuse actual Type Manager query for concrete closed candidates, report incompatible types, construct exactly once via eligible constructor or explicit exact-type factory and capture defaults once. Own each root/gate per runtime, stable type/assembly storage identity with fixed host scope/collision checks, synchronized short reads and helper-backed direct-interface/base event subscriptions with useful incompatible-wiring detection. Include tests/docs/review in this owner; no mapper, backend or scheduler hidden in contracts.
tasks.validation: Focused native identity/host isolation/retention, key and host collision/version policy, constructor/eligibility/default capture, exact-instance reader rejection, direct-interface/optional-base event wiring and negative architecture guards. Establish meaningful Core+Unit builds after actual allocation; inspect names against existing CIS.Configuration and approved dependency closure. Freeze shared seams before W2/W3 and record exact symbols/results, scope/review and real cost.
